items.text: Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR due to foot injury; misses minimum four games.
items.implication: Extended absence; PIT WR depth chart reshuffle.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for other PIT receivers.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor recently; with inactive/trade it is Kia Kendrick Bourne szn. Low recent impact braces for beneficiary upside.
items.why: Production data (5/4 games) plus trade/inactive confirmation.
items.implication: Fade MHJ entirely; pivot to Wilson in ARI offense.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson target share expansion post-MHJ exit.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; team informed him he will be inactive for Sunday vs Detroit as details finalized. No trade completed until after Sunday games.
items.why: Trade imminent; Arizona comfortable with offer after seeking first-round value.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production this week; long-term team change.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining ARI WRs especially Michael Wilson.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: Zero production; handcuff/backup elevation in PHI.
items.opportunity: Increased role for PHI RBs behind Barkley.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.why: Final ETR board; confirmed by coach/insiders.
items.implication: Huntley or backup QB; Ravens offense downgrade.
items.opportunity: Potential slight bump to Flowers/Henry/Andrews volume but overall negative game script risk.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Injury designation plus elevation of backup.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Hemby or other LV RB snaps/carries.

items.why: ETR board; Schefter confirmed Chargers ruled out.
items.implication: LAC WR targets redistribute to McConkey/others.

items.why: Cleared on final board despite ankle notes.
items.implication: Full go expected; pairs with Levitan workload upgrade.

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert listed IN.
items.implication: Start with confidence; reverse any prior benchings.
items.opportunity: Full roles restored for WAS QB, NO WR, PHI TE.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report despite ankle maintenance/limited practice; projects 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with much bigger workload expected after Week 4 usage criticism.
items.why: Fan/media pressure on prior low usage plus clear of injury report; gut for better role vs downside ankle risk.
items.implication: Strong RB start/flex with clear lead over Allgeier.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps/goal-line work in ARI backfield.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson as WR10 vs DET; volume/red-zone in favorable spot, amplified by MHJ inactive.
items.why: Usage and matchup; now primary with MHJ out.

items.text: Fears multi-risk stack for Malik Nabers long-term: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy at QB, and boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman).
items.why: Sore knee DNP plus stacked concerns beyond this week.
items.implication: Monitor closely; not pure set-and-forget despite talent.
items.opportunity: Short-term still viable but elevated reinjury/role risk.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins as WR8 vs TEN; volume including red zone vs defense that struggles vs WRs.
Loves Chase Brown as RB5 @ MIA; workload plus Bengals injury context and soft run defense.
items.why: Workload and matchup; ties to CIN pass-catcher injuries potentially boosting checkdowns.
